Hi Priya — great to hear you kicked the tires, glad it's promising. Monica (our solutions engineer) is cc'd and can cover the runner/private deploy details.

Quick answers up front:
- Yes, we support configurable webhook routing and event filters in the app so you can avoid noisy payloads.
- For large orgs we recommend a combination of webhook filtering + regional routing; we also expose per-tenant rate limit knobs (we can show runtime defaults and tuning in the demo).
- Redwood Private is designed to coexist with on-prem runners; we typically recommend a lightweight connector to bridge runners for secure KV/cache access.

Can we do a 30-minute demo Tue/Wed morning PST? I have slots: Tue 9:00, 10:30, Wed 9:30. Here's my booking page if it's easier: https://cal.com/karthik-redwood/30

Notes for the session: if you could share the top 2-3 integration goals (ingest size, expected token throughput, whether you plan to use self-hosted model variants) we'll tailor the runbook.

Cheers,

Hi Priya — thanks for the detailed notes, and hi Sam. I'm Monica (solutions engineering). I'll cover delivery semantics, network requirements, and the KV/cache architecture during the demo.

Short answers:
- Delivery: our hosted offering provides at-least-once by default with dedup keys; Private gives you the option to tune for idempotency via retries + dedupe middleware. We'll show examples.
- Network: typical egress is to our control plane; for Private we can provide an allowlist of IPs and a VPC connector. I will bring a simple network diagram.
- KV/cache and runners: we often recommend colocated cache nodes for high-throughput orgs; the cache has TLS + mutual auth to prevent cross-site leakage.

Confirming Tue 10:30 PST for a 30-min demo — I'll send the invite after a quick prep call with Karthik. Can you share a rough count of active repos and expected events/sec?

Cheers,
